item.statement: Interface, algorithm, numerical, and memory planes must cohere so that i32 arithmetic is representable, floor-modulo is used (not C remainder), f32 values are copied exactly, and padded source/output columns are never part of the logical operation.

plans.objective: Cross-check candidate types, index arithmetic, and padding handling for coherence.
plans.observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate source artifact and read the index arithmetic.
plans.pass_condition: Pass iff the candidate uses representable i32 addition, mathematical floor-modulo for both axes, exact f32 loads/stores, and restricts reads/writes to logical width-by-height cells.
plans.setup: Inspect the candidate shift addition, floor-modulo computation, row stride usage, and logical bounds; verify no C remainder (%) is used for negative values and no padded source column is read.
